CONTRACT FOR FEAT-002: Endpoint route = GET /api/auth/me/permissions on the UA host (controller [Route("api/[controller]")] + [HttpGet("me/permissions")]), [Authorize] on that action only; login/logout/refresh/change-password remain anonymous. Through the API gateway the UI composes it under the UA prefix (shared axios base .../api/ua/api -> gateway forwards to ua-cluster), i.e. the UI calls `/auth/me/permissions` relative to that base. Wire JSON (System.Text.Json default camelCase, verified by contract records MyPermissionsResponse(bool IsAdmin, IReadOnlyList<ScreenPermissionResponse> Programs) and ScreenPermissionResponse(string ProgramName, bool CanAdd, bool CanModify, bool CanQuery, bool CanDelete)): { "isAdmin": bool, "programs": [ { "programName": string, "canAdd": bool, "canModify": bool, "canQuery": bool, "canDelete": bool } ] }. SEMANTICS the UI must mirror: isAdmin=true (role Admin OR SystemAdmin) returns EVERY active program with all four flags true (UI should treat isAdmin as a global bypass - enable all controls regardless of per-program flags). isAdmin=false returns ONLY active programs the user has at least one access row for (programs with no rows are omitted; a screen absent from `programs` means no access). Per-program flags are the OR across the user's multiple UserAccessAssignment rows for that ProgramName. ProgramName is the screen key - use the programname_map in context.json (e.g. DcnMaster->DocumentNumberControl, OrgHierarchyMaster->OrganizationHierarchy, UserManagementMaster->UserManagement) to map UI pages to keys. Seeded active program keys: LookupMaster, NationalityMaster, OrganizationHierarchy, DocumentNumberControl, CourtMaster, EntityMaster, UserManagement, LocationMaster, Organization. UA JwtBearer validates using config Jwt:SigningKey (SystemAdmin pattern); UA appsettings already had Issuer/Audience/SigningKey, and TokenService signs with Jwt:Secret which equals SigningKey in UA appsettings, so tokens validate. User id resolved from ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier with sub fallback. Nothing was committed.
